purpose: Country resilience contract for the unified index. Canonical country records are local and remain readable without optional live enrichment.
missing_value_policy: Render Unknown / Not yet sourced / Not applicable according to field state. Never convert missing data to zero.

live_fetch_policy.error_label: Live enrichment unavailable — repository data shown

acceptance: Opening any canonical country ID through index.html must produce useful local content with network access disabled.
